optimizationCandidatesExamined.candidate: worker/src/__tests__/otelReplay.properties.test.ts - reduce fast-check numRuns or split the two properties across files
optimizationCandidatesExamined.reasoning: 13.19s across 2 property tests at numRuns:128 each is ~52ms per generated case, which is efficient for a property that round-trips OTEL spans through the replay harness and asserts persisted rows. Lowering numRuns would reduce coverage, which the standing rules forbid. Splitting the file for worker-pool parallelism would recover ~6.6s on a shard that already has ~115s of slack against the e2e critical path, i.e. zero effect on perceived CI time, and would disturb a harness the author explicitly commented as concurrency-sensitive ('The replay writer retries internally; Vitest retries could overlap an unfinished replay and race the shared writer singleton', with retry:0 set deliberately).

optimizationCandidatesExamined.reasoning: Tests inside one file run serially, so this file is the longest pole within the web shard. But the web shard finishes ~120s before e2e-tests, so shortening it cannot move perceived time. Report-only.
